name: CP 47,497
summary: CP 47,497 or (C7)-CP 47,497 is a cannabinoid receptor agonist drug, developed by Pfizer in the 1980s. It has analgesic effects and is used in scientific research.1 nM.

pharmacology.text: CP 47,497 or (C7)-CP 47,497 is a cannabinoid receptor agonist drug, developed by Pfizer in the 1980s. It is a potent CB1 agonist with a Kd of 2.1 nM.

uses.text: CP 47,497 or (C7)-CP 47,497 is a cannabinoid receptor agonist drug, developed by Pfizer in the 1980s. It has analgesic effects and is used in scientific research.

summaryZh: CP 47,497（也稱為-CP 47,497，化學名：2-[-3-羥基環己基]-5-(1,1-二甲基庚基)苯酚，2-[-3-hydroxycyclohexyl]-5-phenol）是一種有機化合物，分子式C21H34O2，屬於人工合成的大麻素，1980年代由輝瑞公司開發。
summaryZhHans: CP 47,497（也称为-CP 47,497，化学名：2-[-3-羟基环己基]-5-(1,1-二甲基庚基)苯酚，2-[-3-hydroxycyclohexyl]-5-phenol）是一种有机化合物，分子式C21H34O2，属于人工合成的大麻素，1980年代由辉瑞公司开发。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it from controlled studies in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, anxiety, paranoia, vomiting, psychosis, seizures and kidney injury, and their effects are often stronger and less predictable than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前缺乏人體對照研究的資料。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳過快、焦慮、妄想、嘔吐、精神病症狀、癲癇發作與腎臟損傷，作用往往比大麻更強、更難預測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前缺乏人体对照研究的数据。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳过快、焦虑、妄想、呕吐、精神病症状、癫痫发作与肾脏损伤，作用往往比大麻更强、更难预测。

fact.en: It drops one of the three rings of THC, which is why chemists call it a non-classical cannabinoid. A close relative with one extra carbon on its side chain was found in Spice products in 2009.
fact.zh: 它少了 THC 三個環中的一個，因此化學家稱它為非典型大麻素。2009 年在 Spice 產品中發現了它的近親，只是側鏈多了一個碳。
fact.zhHans: 它少了 THC 三个环中的一个，因此化学家称它为非典型大麻素。2009 年在 Spice 产品中发现了它的近亲，只是侧链多了一个碳。
